comparison.interpretation: Matched-model simulated performance; accuracy not measured

compute_counter_semantics.aggregate_rule: Sum command counters except keys max or *_max, which use maximum across commands. Matrix-gap sum counts closed inter-matrix gaps; pending correlations can include the final unclosed tail.
compute_counter_semantics.compute_only: Cycles with core_busy and !read_path_busy during EX_RUN.
compute_counter_semantics.core: core_busy cycles, including GEMM execution stages; this is not a count of active PE lanes or executed MAC operations.
compute_counter_semantics.engine_window: NPU_* engine probes count only exec_state == EX_RUN, reset per accepted Conv/FC command; control/setup cycles outside EX_RUN are excluded.
compute_counter_semantics.operand: read_path_busy cycles, including the operand service path; this is not exclusively external DDR latency.
compute_counter_semantics.operand_only: Cycles with read_path_busy and !core_busy during EX_RUN; these show exposed operand-path activity, not causal proof that DDR alone stalled the core.
compute_counter_semantics.overlap: Cycles with both core_busy and read_path_busy during EX_RUN.
compute_counter_semantics.pending_load: A/B in-flight load correlation counters can overlap each other and other states; do not add them as independent stall durations.
compute_counter_semantics.stalled_requests: a/b_load_wait and a/b_acquire_wait record denied request/grant handshakes; zero does not imply zero operand service time.
compute_counter_semantics.write_bytes: Accepted AXI32 write beat popcount(WSTRB), including partial logical tails.

configuration.write_byte_accounting: sum popcount(WSTRB) over accepted AXI write beats
